_doc: Frozen out-of-sample specification for bid_absorption entry on ESH6. No parameter changes after ESH6 data is pulled. Written 2026-03-07 before any ESH6 data examined.

instrument.note: Roll date: ESZ5 expired 2025-12-20; ESH6 is the current front month as of frozen date

step_1_signal.note: Same signal generation as in-sample. No signal parameter changes.

step_2_dsr_gate.alignment: ask-side for longs, bid-side for shorts
step_2_dsr_gate.exclusion_policy: skip sessions containing FOMC_DECISION, NFP, or CPI events

step_3_absorption_window.note: Arm when price first moves >= 3 ticks adverse from bar_close_mid within window

step_4_signature.note: ask_exhausted and aggressor_flip showed definitively negative EV on ESZ5 in-sample. Only bid_absorption is tested OOS.

entry.long: ask_px at the tick bid_absorption fires
entry.short: bid_px at the tick bid_absorption fires

stop_loss.long: bid_absorption_px - 0.25 (1 tick below the absorbed bid level)
stop_loss.short: bid_absorption_px + 0.25 (1 tick above the absorbed ask level)
stop_loss.rationale: Absorption level breaking by 1 tick means the absorbed bid/ask failed — thesis violated. Distance from entry is always ~1 tick (entry at ask = bid+1t, SL at bid-1t).
stop_loss.note: This eliminates the arm_sl_dist <= 0 ambiguity entirely. SL anchored to absorption level, not arm level.

take_profit.rationale: Lowest TP with positive EV on ESZ5 in-sample (EV = +0.20t at TP=8t, SL=1t). Lower TPs are negative EV.

in_sample_evidence.note_direction_skew: All 15 ESZ5 in-sample bid_absorption fires were shorts. Verify direction distribution on ESH6 before treating as direction-agnostic.

out_of_sample_test_criteria.no_parameter_adjustments: If ESH6 win rate is 10-13% (below in-sample but above breakeven), this is inconclusive — do NOT adjust TP downward to manufacture positive EV.

what_is_not_tested.ask_exhausted: Negative EV on ESZ5 (arm-SL too wide at 3t for 1.5t entry dip). Not validated OOS.
what_is_not_tested.aggressor_flip: Fires too rarely (3/69 windows) on ESZ5 to assess. Not validated OOS.
what_is_not_tested.ask_absorbed: Never fires on ESZ5 with 50-lot threshold. Not validated OOS.
